fields.descriptionHtml:
Carry a reliable bamboo water bottle 500ml stainless steel insulated water bottle that holds your drink through the commute and the gym.

Why It Keeps Up With Your Day

  • Double wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12 hours.
  • Natural bamboo lid with a leak proof silicone seal.
  • BPA free 18/8 stainless steel body that fits most car cup holders.

What You Get

500 ml capacity in a BPA free 18/8 stainless steel body topped with a natural bamboo lid.

Made For Commutes And Workouts

The size fits most car cup holders so it stays secure on the drive, then travels easily into the gym.

Care And Guarantee

Hand wash the lid. The bottle is covered by a 1 year warranty.
